test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Manish Narwal is related to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shooting.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Manish Narwal (born 17 October 2001) is an Indian **Para Pistol Shooter.**
 
• He ranks fourth in the world in **Men's 10m Air Pistol SH1 **according to the World Shooting Para Sports Rankings.
 
• Manish is also supported by **GoSports Foundation through the Para Champions Programme.**
 
• Shooting has inspired competition, and in several countries, rifle clubs started to form in the 1**9th century**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b105a54d1d70fb842c5768ce6a509a3aaefd376701a45c032d8c814d59b7ce6e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wrestling** is a hand-to-hand combat system and a set of combat sports involving **grappling-type techniques.**
 
• **Badminton **is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• **Cycling, also called bicycling or biking**, is the use of bicycles for transport, recreation, exercise or sport.
